subject: general
question: If 15% of A ∶ 25% of B :: 8 ∶ 11, then A ∶ B is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **proportion** a : b :: c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means.

(15% × A) × 11 = (25% × B) × 8

15 × A × 11 = 25 × B × 8 (Percentage cancels out)

A / B = (25 × 8) / (15 × 11) = (5 × 8) / (3 × 11) = 40 / 33

**∴ The correct answer is 40 : 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**15% of A : 25% of B = 8 : 11**

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of **x% of A** to **y% of B** is (x × A) / (y × B).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddc52cb9d75400c212c3014c1c9dc24c6d303a000cba66348921e9f06eca6ebc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (15/100) × A / (25/100) × B = 8 / 11

⇒ (15 × A) / (25 × B) = 8 / 11

⇒ (3 × A) / (5 × B) = 8 / 11

⇒ 3A × 11 = 8 × 5B

⇒ 33A = 40B

⇒ A / B = 40 / 33

**∴ The correct answer is 40 : 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Proportion

If a : b :: c : d, then the product of extremes (a × d) is always equal to the product of means (b × c).

Percentage Ratios

When comparing percentages of two different quantities, the common denominator (100) can be canceled out directly: x% of A / y% of B = (x × A) / (y × B).

Compounded Ratio

The compounded ratio of (a : b) and (c : d) is (a × c) : (b × d). This is useful when multiple ratios are linked.</p
